correctness.rationale: Exact local empty-arc probabilities give independent exponential limits. Uniqueness of the parent triangle as its own maximal inscribed triangle localizes all near maxima; the barycentric determinant has first-order loss equal to the sum of corner displacements, so the maximizing deficit agrees with the three minima after scaling. A deterministic bound by twice their sum plus exact exponential marginal tails proves all positive moments. Pair-rate survival and finite-dimensional majorization yield the sharp whole-law envelope; elementary symmetric algebra yields two-moment inversion. The embedded numerical verifier was executed successfully, but finite checks are supplementary.
